_doc: Instrument routing classifier for tools/*.mjs. This repo ships TWO games behind one dev server: the SHIPPED 2D fighter (?fight=1/__FIGHT__, ?play=1/__PLAY__ — FightRenderer + FightVfx/ProjectileLayer) and a LEGACY card battler (?lab=1/__OPS3D__ — FightScene3D+VfxSubsystem; and __game turn-based combat UI). A metric gathered from a card route is inadmissible as evidence about the fighter. Enforced by src/__tests__/instrumentRouting.node.test.ts.

_cardTokens._note: Presence of any of these in a tool’s CODE (comments ignored) marks it as touching the card battler. window.__game / startMatch alone is NOT a card token — it is the shared app store; the renderer depends on the route.

_buckets.card-lab: CARD BATTLER via ?lab=1 / __OPS3D__ (ThreeLab → FightScene3D + VfxSubsystem). Inadmissible as shipped-fighter evidence.
_buckets.card-ui: CARD BATTLER combat UI via __game store + turn-based rail (.combat-turn-prompt / MoveCard / castMove). Inadmissible as shipped-fighter evidence.
_buckets.dual: Default route is the SHIPPED fighter (--route fight, __FIGHT__); the card lab is reachable only via --route lab. Puppet cmds (hit/pose/...) error unless --route lab.
_buckets.meta: Route/infra verifier: legitimately names EVERY route (incl. card) because verifying routing is its job. Exempt from the card-token purity rule.
_buckets.stranded: Boots bare `/` + pokes the __game store; the front door (e149691) makes bare `/` the title card, so this now grabs the title. Not admissible until given an explicit route.
_buckets.generic: Capture/probe util whose URL is supplied by the caller (no hardcoded game). Safe by construction only if the caller passes a shipped route.
_buckets.shipped-audio: SHIPPED fighter audio instrument (no card route/handle).
_buckets.analysis: Offline / route-agnostic: reads PNGs, atlases or JSON, or measures on a blank page. Not tied to either game.
_buckets.shipped-ui: SHIPPED React shell: menu / character-select / stage-select / ceremony / HUD / attract. Real product, not the card game.
_buckets.shipped-fight: SHIPPED fighter via ?fight=1 / __FIGHT__ (deterministic FightHarness → FightRenderer + FightVfx / ProjectileLayer).
_buckets.shipped-play: SHIPPED fighter via ?play=1 / matchup params / __PLAY__ (live PlayableMatch → FightRenderer + FightVfx / ProjectileLayer).

_rules.invariant: Every tool whose bucket is NOT in allowedToContainCardTokens must contain ZERO card tokens in code. card-lab must contain a route/handle card token. The dual tool must default to a shipped route.

attract-census.note: SHIPPED attract reel (src/screens/attract). Drives the PURE AttractDirector frame-for-frame in node — no browser, no renderer, no route — and censuses the fraction of SIM frames that are money shots (super/KO/heavy) vs footsies. Output is screen-time COMPOSITION and is load-invariant (a fraction of simulated frames, identical on an idle or saturated box); it is NOT fps. Card-clean: imports only the reel director + the shipped fighter sim. Run with `npx tsx`; `--selftest` is the mutation guard.
